title: From Image → Character → Animation ⚡️
author: Feisty-Scheme-8356
selftext: img2threejs v1.5 turns a single image into an editable 3D character - ready to customize and animate.

comments.author: DiscoverWhereAt
comments.body: superb work man , will you work on rigging to help save the community? lol

replies.author: ElwinLewis
replies.body: We are dying out here… I’m making a “StarDiabloDew” game and so far everything literally everything else is going amazing except animations. We are spoiled though in these days

replies.author: Feisty-Scheme-8356
replies.body: Haha I feel you, Animation is always the tricky part. lol

replies.author: DiscoverWhereAt
replies.body: I agree although AI has helped a HEAP , once we can actually get it to assist with animations or advanced VFX THEN we can REALLY take this copiloting solo dev to another level

replies.author: Feisty-Scheme-8356
replies.body:
Thank you! 😄 Actually, rigging is already working in img2threejs, I’m using it in the current pipeline.

The goal has always been to create assets that are not just visually accurate, but also structured and ready for animation and interaction.

Still improving it step by step, but it’s already a fun part of the workflow

replies.author: Feisty-Scheme-8356
replies.body:
Thank you! Glad you find it useful.

The goal is to make 3D creation more accessible by turning references into assets that developers can actually edit, animate, and build with.
